We have mass spec: m/z 182.07316494187 (intensity 100) etc. Likely molecular ion at 182.07. The formula from candidate O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2 is C13H10O, which has exact mass: C13=13*12.0000=156, H10=10*1.007825=10.07825, O=15.994915 => total 182.073165. Matches mass spec. Proton NMR shows 10H aromatic multiplet at 7.51 ppm, consistent with biphenyl ketone (benzophenone). Indeed benzophenone (diphenyl ketone) formula C13H10O, aromatic protons 10. So SMILES: O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2 (or O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2). That matches. IR likely carbonyl. So answer is that SMILES.

We should maybe validate SMILES. Use validate_smiles.
